sources.snippet: The Patch est la plateforme IA qui connecte les meilleurs recruteurs aux meilleurs candidats — et prépare chacun à réussir.

sources.title: thepatch/foundation-1-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Foundation-1 was trained for 4- or 8-bar clips at 100, 110, 120, 128, 130, 140, or 150 BPM. The prompt should include the selected bar count and BPM. sa3.cpp's Foundation profile calculates the exact sample crop, the whole-second seconds_totalconditioning value, and the padded Oobleck latent canvas independently to match RoyalCities' inference.
